review_scope: Final delta of startup identity, source pins, pre-listen entry, stop/signal handling, and overlay/bundle closure. Native shared executor, budget and result validation received a separate android_inference review and are not requalified as phone behavior here.

previous_blocker.description: SIGTERM accepted after the initial post-model cancellation check could be consumed by a flag-only handler, then forgotten when the old handler was restored, allowing a health-success return toward the listener.
previous_blocker.fix: Only default terminating SIGTERM and default SIGINT policies are admitted. During supervision cancellation is sticky. After result validation, the original terminating handlers are restored before a final poll and sticky gate check. Signals before restoration cause failure; signals after restoration terminate instead of being swallowed. Success evidence explicitly records listener_ready=false.
